name: PF Step 8 Test Runner
description: Fake Calendly events for step 8 tests (T7 cancel, T8 reschedule, T11 host guard, T5c). Manual only. DWN-6.

parameters.content:
## PF Step 8 Test Runner
Sends fake Calendly events (times relative to now) for T7 (cancel before the check), T8 (reschedule), T11 (host not allowed) and T5c (no rebook answer) to **PF Calendly Capture**. Then run **PF Show-up Check**.
